description: Update HelpSupportActivity.kt to replace the fake 900ms delay with a real API call to POST /api/support. Depends on FEAT-001 (the endpoint must exist). The Android change is isolated to one method in one file.
steps: Open 'c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\hookaDrop App\HookahDrop\app\src\main\java\com\hookahdrop\app\HelpSupportActivity.kt'. Ensure these imports are present (add any that are missing): 'import kotlinx.coroutines.*', 'import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope', 'import org.json.JSONObject'. The file already imports from com.hookahdrop.app.network and com.hookahdrop.app.data via BaseProfileActivity; ApiClient and session are available.

Replace the entire body of setupSubmit() — specifically the b.btnSubmit.setOnClickListener lambda — keeping the existing validation block (subject empty check, category == 0 check, description.length < 20 check) unchanged. After the validation passes, replace the fake postDelayed block with: b.btnSubmit.isEnabled = false; b.btnSubmit.text = "Sending..."; lifecycleScope.launch { val body = JSONObject().apply { put("subject", subject); put("category", b.spinnerCategory.selectedItem.toString()); put("description", description); put("orderNumber", b.etOrderNumber.text.toString().trim()) }; val response = com.hookahdrop.app.network.ApiClient.post("/api/support", body, session.getJwtToken()); if (response.isSuccess) { showSuccessDialog(); clearForm() } else { toast(response.userFriendlyError()) }; b.btnSubmit.isEnabled = true; b.btnSubmit.text = "Submit Request" }. Keep showSuccessDialog() and clearForm() methods exactly as they are.
Do NOT change the layout XML, the FAQ section, the category spinner setup, or any other method in the file. Only setupSubmit() changes.
acceptance_criteria: The Android project compiles without errors: .\gradlew assembleDebug completes successfully
Tapping Submit with empty subject shows the existing field error (no API call made)
Tapping Submit with valid fields disables the button and shows 'Sending...' text while the request is in flight
On success, the success dialog appears and the form is cleared
On network error or server error, a toast with the error message is shown and the button is re-enabled
The admin email arrives at hookadrop@gmail.com after a successful submission from the app
The user confirmation email arrives at the logged-in user's email address
verification: Build: cd 'c:\Users\GAMING\Downloads\raaa\e-commerce-backend-main\hookaDrop App\HookahDrop' && .\gradlew assembleDebug — expect BUILD SUCCESSFUL
Install the APK on a device or emulator connected to the same network as the backend
Navigate to Profile > Help & Support, fill subject, select a category, enter a description of 20+ chars, tap Submit Request
Confirm: button disables briefly, success dialog appears, form clears
Confirm: admin email received at hookadrop@gmail.com
Confirm: confirmation email received at the test user's email
Turn off the backend server and repeat — confirm error toast appears and button re-enables
findings: Replaced postDelayed fake simulation with lifecycleScope.launch { ApiClient.post('/api/support', body, session.getJwtToken()) }. Added imports: androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope, kotlinx.coroutines.launch, org.json.JSONObject. All validation logic and showSuccessDialog()/clearForm() methods left unchanged. Build: BUILD SUCCESSFUL (Gradle assembleDebug, 2m). Committed in the 'hookaDrop App' submodule (commit a9155bd). Note: session.getJwtToken() returns nullable String? which ApiClient.post() accepts as token parameter — no cast needed. The EMAIL_PASSWORD in .env must still be set to a real Gmail App Password for emails to actually deliver.
